offering_description.value: Produces and sells potash and Trio (potassium magnesium sulfate) fertilizer from mines in New Mexico to agricultural, industrial and animal feed customers. Also sells water and provides disposal services to oil and gas operators in the Permian Basin. Products are made by solution mining and solar evaporation.

primary_products.value: potash; Trio langbeinite fertilizer; salt; magnesium chloride

primary_services.value: water sales to oil and gas operators; wastewater disposal; oilfield water services

customer_segment.value: B2B: fertilizer distributors and retailers, farmers, industrial and animal feed customers, oil and gas operators

end_markets.value: agriculture; oil and gas; animal feed; industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: potash and Trio fertilizer sold by the ton; service fees: water sales and disposal services to oil and gas operators

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines and evaporates potash and langbeinite from New Mexico deposits, sold to fertilizer distributors and industrial users; service provider: supplies water and disposal to Permian Basin oil and gas operators

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily US agricultural regions including the Southwest, Midwest, South and California, some industrial customers

specialization.value: related lines: potash and Trio fertilizer plus water services and byproducts, all tied to New Mexico land and resources

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: fertilizer wholesalers and retailers; direct sales: industrial, feed and oilfield customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining safety (MSHA), environmental and water rules, BLM leases and New Mexico oil and gas water disposal regulation
